name: B10-0424/2026 – After recital L – Am 27
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: La. whereas incidents around FEMYSO have recurred during the European Parliament’s European Youth Events (EYEs); whereas the recurring controversies surrounding FEMYSO’s participation highlight the institutional and reputational risks arising from its presence; whereas Parliament’s Bureau and its various working groups have held several exchanges of views over the past years on the organisation of the EYE, including on the establishment of a code of conduct and the selection criteria of civil society co-organisers; whereas the case of FEMYSO has been discussed on several occasions in that context; whereas FEMYSO was still able to hold its annual European Day of Action Against Islamophobia event on Parliament’s premises on 21 September 2026 as a Member outreach event hosted by Members of The Left/GUE;
